questions.e: The tech-heavy Nasdaq fell about 2.5% to 24,509.76, compared with about 1.9% for the S&P 500 and 1.4% for the Dow, as a sell-off in tech and AI stocks deepened.
questions.h: Think about which index is packed with tech stocks.
questions.q: Which major U.S. index had the biggest percentage drop on Monday, Nov 16?

questions.e: Nvidia shares fell about 4.1% and were again the biggest drag on Wall Street, as worries over the company's leadership shake-up continued.
questions.h: It was a loss, but a single-digit one.
questions.q: How did Nvidia's stock move on Monday, Nov 16, the day before its earnings report?

questions.e: The Dow fell 739.38 points, or 1.4%, to close at 51,608.17. With the Dow above 50,000, a 1.4% drop works out to roughly 740 points.
questions.q: About how many points did the Dow Jones Industrial Average lose on Nov 16?

questions.e: The 10-year Treasury yield finished the day a little above 5%, near where it ended the prior Friday. Higher yields raise borrowing costs across the economy, from mortgages to corporate debt.
questions.h: It is the same level the yield was hovering near the week before.
questions.q: On Nov 16 the 10-year Treasury yield held above which round-number level?

questions.e: Nvidia was set to report quarterly results after U.S. trading ended Tuesday, its first report since Jensen Huang stepped down, with interim CEO Colette Kress set to speak to Wall Street.
questions.h: It is the chipmaker that dominated Monday's headlines.
questions.q: Which closely watched event was scheduled for after the closing bell on Tuesday, Nov 17?
